description: This file defines core service management classes and interfaces for a plugin or component system within the WPEFramework. It includes service metadata, factory, and administrator classes, as well as macros for interface querying and registration.

classes.name: IServiceMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing metadata about a service, including name, module, and version info.

classes.name: ServiceAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing registration, creation, and lifecycle of services and libraries.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Template class that turns a service implementation into a managed service with reference counting.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Template class implementing reference counting for sink objects, with safety checks on destruction.

classes.name: ServiceMetadata
classes.description: Template class that registers service metadata and factory, enabling service creation and version info.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of a service or interface, with template specialization for interface extraction.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Method for querying supported interfaces by their ID.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count for object lifetime management.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and potentially destroys the object.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a service metadata and factory with the ServiceAdministrator.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a service metadata and factory.

methods.name: LoadLibrary
methods.description: Loads a dynamic library by name.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets a callback object for service lifecycle notifications.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Creates an instance of a service given library, name, version, and interface number.
